title: publish.unit handler (claim-before-publish, dry-run, idempotent)
description: Implement the publish.unit core: zod-validate payload; load asset+queue row (JOIN); re-check isPublishEligible (fail-closed); run disclosure gate; resolve connector via registry; CLAIM url_registry 'publishing' (claimUrlRegistry) — if not winner, resolve as no-op; build PublishRequest (carry disclosure_tag, dryRun, customerId); call connector.publish(); on PublishOk → markUrlRegistryPublished + markDeployStatus('published') + enqueue publish.verify; on PublishDryRun → insertUrlRegistryDryRun (no queue terminal change beyond releasing lease back to 'queued'); on PublishThrottled → requeue to 'queued' + throw RetryableJobError(delay); on NOT_CONFIGURED → mark registry 'failed', queue back to 'queued', resolve (no retry); on retryable error → RetryableJobError; else queue 'failed' + DLQ. Catch unique-violation as no-op.
acceptanceCriteria: a redelivered job after a successful publish does NOT call connector.publish() a second time (claim lost)
dry-run leaves the queue row claimable for a later real publish (not stranded)
throttled deferral re-queues to 'queued', never drops
unique-violation does not dead-letter as 'failed'

acceptanceCriteria: stub channels are never enqueued and their rows remain 'queued'
stale leases are reclaimed to 'queued' before claiming
no more than the remaining throttle budget is leased per (customer,channel)
singletonKey prevents double-enqueue of the same asset+channel
